description: Otter.ai meeting transcription and AI notetaker with an MCP integration for AI assistants.
auth_notes: No source states how credentials are sent for Otter.ai's MCP or any API. Docs for tryotter (delivery) and otterab (A/B testing) are different products.
gate_detail: Sources do not say how a developer obtains credentials or whether a plan is required. The MCP posts are marketed around enterprise use, but no gate is stated.
api_scope: Otter.ai is described as offering an MCP integration so AI assistants can read meeting transcripts; no public REST API is documented in the sources.
mcp_notes: Otter's own blog posts describe an Otter MCP for pulling meeting intelligence into ChatGPT, Claude and other clients; no URL given.
blocker_detail: Auth method, plan requirements and any developer API for Otter.ai are not stated; only blog marketing about MCP is available.

evidence.quote: If your team lives in ChatGPT, Claude, or any other MCP-compatible chat app, they can pull Otter meeting intelligence directly into those tools.
Otter's own AI Chat connects outward to your enterprise apps via MCP: Notion, Jira, Salesforce, Google Docs, Gmail, Slack, and more.
Otter for Enterprise: Connect AI-to-AI with Otter’s MCP
